overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: two members met separately with the health agent and counsel without proposing changes, and credited their affidavits denying any member-to-member contact, so no quorum deliberated.

allegations.summary: Board members allegedly shared a document with the Board's health agent and counsel, who then relayed it, before the August 5 meeting.
allegations.key_passage: However, public body members may communicate with individuals who are not members of a public body, so long as in doing so they do not facilitate a serial deliberation.

allegations.summary: Board members allegedly deliberated outside an open meeting on the document before the Board's August 5 meeting.
allegations.key_passage: Because a quorum of the Board's members did not communicate outside of a noticed meeting regarding business within the Board's jurisdiction, we find that there was no deliberation and thus no violation of the Open Meeting Law.
